headline: Thanh Hau Nguyen rises to 27th on ARC-2 at 63.89

sections.text: Thanh Hau Nguyen gained 9.17 points in the past day, moving from 39th to 27th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board at 63.89. The earlier comparison score was 54.72.

This is a follow-up score gain, not a new debut. Nguyen remains outside the provisional gold places, whose score line stands at 68.75. The public standings establish the result, not the method behind it.
